buffer-red.note: The syntax theme's keyword red, as the --color-buffer-red token: what ends the session in the lanes (a rejected refresh, the cleared storage, the route guard's redirect).

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Live Source"**

The page is a code buffer at stage scale. The buffer is set in Geist Mono, numbered down a line-number gutter, and divided by hairline rules; only the plain-prose leads under section heads switch to Geist, the family's sans. Headings are comments, with a dim `//` in front. Copy is comments. The hero is the buffer's first thirteen lines: the pitch, a lead comment, the install prompt, then the real `createAuth` config from Getting started, whose `refresh` line is live. Under it, one illustrative hour plays as four lanes of 62 cells (signed in, refresh, storage, other tabs).

The surface is ink, flat, dark only. Lime is the one colour with a voice, and it speaks only for what is live or playing, plus the single primary action. Nothing is carded, lifted or blurred. Controls are set in the buffer's type; tabs are file names; lists are rows between hairlines. The density is a code editor's: tight lines, generous section breaks.

Scope today. The dark retint of Fumadocs, the brand colours, the font import and the selection and caret colours apply site-wide (`app.css`, under `.dark` and `html`). The buffer face, the gutter, comment headings, lanes and everything in Components below are landing-only, scoped by the `.live-source` class on the landing's layout. The docs pages still use Fumadocs' own type and shapes; they take this world in a later step, with a proportional companion face for prose that is not chosen yet.
keyCharacteristics: One family: Geist Mono for the buffer, Geist (sans) for prose leads and the docs.
Line numbers only on code; prose, numbers and lane names share one left edge.
Comments as copy: `//` lead-ins and a `/* … */` block for asides.
Hairline rules instead of boxes; square corners throughout.
Lime only for live state and the one primary action; foreground for selection.
Motion that plays an hour, pauses off screen, and stands still under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Live Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime marks only what is live or playing, and the one primary action. Selected tabs, pressed switches and hovered links never turn lime: they turn foreground.

rules.name: The Exact Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime is used at its full value or not at all. No opacity, no tint, no lime behind a blur. That is why the landing navbar is solid ink.

rules.name: The Readable Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every text pairing on ink keeps at least 4.5:1. Comment grey is the floor for text; the lane greys are for cells, not words.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: The site uses Geist and Geist Mono and nothing else. On the landing the mono is the voice; the sans is for running prose only. Hierarchy comes from weight, size and the quiet/loud colour pair.

rules.name: The Comment Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings and copy are written as comments: a comment-grey `//` (hidden from screen readers) in front of a sentence-case line. Asides use a `/* … */` block. No uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Flat Buffer Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page lifts off the ink. A surface that needs separating gets a hairline; a state that needs showing gets a veil, a foreground underline or, if it is live, lime.

dos: Do set the landing in Geist Mono, and only running prose (section leads, docs text) in Geist.
Do write headings and copy as comments, with a comment-grey `//` hidden from screen readers.
Do number only code; set prose at the column edge, level with the line numbers.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines and full-width rows, not boxes.
Do use lime at its exact value, only for live or playing state and the one primary action.
Do show selection (active tab, pressed switch) in foreground with a 2px foreground underline.
Do keep every text pairing at 4.5:1 or better and every label at 11px or larger.
Do give every animation a still, complete state for reduced motion, and stop it off screen.
donts: Don't tint, fade or blur lime, or place translucent chrome over it.
Don't use lime for selected tabs, toggles or link hovers.
Don't add cards, drop shadows, gradients or rounded corners to landing elements.
Don't introduce a typeface outside the Geist family.
Don't add a light mode or a theme switch; the site is dark only.
Don't apply a queued edit mid-hour while the hour is playing.
